backfillRows.why: The conscious mind's Granted Spells ladder prints exactly one spell per rank 1-9, with Sending on the 6th rung: our own text (core-descriptions.json/classFeatures/the-silent-whisper, imported from the book) carries "- 6th: Sending". The AoN mirror doc conscious-mind-10 mis-transcribes that rung as a second "**5th** Sending" (leaving no 6th), which is why our flat-id lane files Sending under spells/sending.rank = 5 and a Silent Whisper psychic gets two 5th-rank granted spells and none at 6th. The ladder now carries the granted rank so the rung, not the spell's own rank, decides the slot. Superseded row: the shipped classFeatures/conscious-mind.grantedSpells value dumped whole, with only {"id":"sending","level":11,"rank":6} added to the-silent-whisper.

findings.note: VERIFIER (batch 034, engine): the builder shipped the READER and left the row that feeds it in DATA STILL NEEDED, so the finding would have closed with an unfed reader. The row is emitted here instead. src/rules/build.ts now files a granted spell under the ladder entry's `rank` when it carries one (`ladderRank`), falling back to the spell's own rank exactly as before; this row is the only thing in the dataset that sets one. It SUPERSEDES the existing effect-backfill row for classFeatures/conscious-mind/grantedSpells — the value above is that row's value dumped whole with the single rung {id:sending, level:11, rank:6} added to the-silent-whisper and nothing else changed (diffed against the shipped overlay row). Print (Player Core psychic, and our own core-descriptions.json/classFeatures/the-silent-whisper) reads "- 6th: Sending"; sending's own rank is 5, so without it rung 5 held two grants and rung 6 none. level 11 is the level a psychic gains 6th-rank slots, so the ladder gate withholds nothing it should give. DO NOT author this row a second time from the report's DATA STILL NEEDED list.

Code-only: `typeOptional: true` on RAGE_DAMAGE['spirit-instinct'] makes rageStrikeRider() print both branches of a per-Rage choice ('3 spirit or 2 bludgeoning (choose each Rage)'). Deliberately the label, not a mode: an exclusive-group mode would need a modes-bucket row and would make the player toggle something print says is chosen at the table each Rage.
